payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team of ecommerce specialists for customer Marisol Vega, who claims she was charged more than the advertised promotion on delivered order #. She provided a screenshot of the product page showing a weekend banner and a document invoice from her email receipt. Reference entity IDs: customer id, order id #. MANDATORY steps: 1. identity_verifier must authenticate Marisol Vega before any credit or refund action is considered, 2. order_specialist must inspect the authoritative order and relevant product details to confirm what was purchased and charged, 3. knowledge_specialist must consult the exact pricing-dispute and expired-promotion guidance to determine whether the screenshot is sufficient for adjustment, 4. refund_specialist must determine the correct financial remedy path and only issue a refund or store credit if policy and order facts support it, 5. commerce_ops_manager must provide the final decision and rationale.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- invoice order EC 66703 email receipt: Email receipt document for delivered order #EC-66703 containing billing details, line items, totals, delivery status, and timestamp. Extracted content: EC T18 Invoice Order EC 66703 Email Receipt Email receipt document for delivered order #EC-66703 containing billing details, line items, totals, delivery status, and timestamp. Details Document Title Your order has been delivered Customer Name Marisol Vega Customer Id CUS-66703 Order Id EC-66703 Order Status Delivered Delivery Timestamp Sunday, July 14, 2024 2:18 PM Billing Address 1482 Willow Bend Apt 5C, San Antonio, TX 78205 Line Item 1 GlowSkin Vitamin C Serum 30 mL Line Item 1 Quantity 1 Promotion Line Weekend Flash Sale - 15% off Payment Method Visa ending in 1184 Billing Email = Marisol Billing Email marisol.vega@example.com Line Item 1 Unit Price = $39 Line Item 1 Unit Price $39.99 Promotion Discount Amount = -$6 Promotion Discount Amount -$6.00 Order Total = $39 Order Total $39.31 Additional Information a realistic 2-page ecommerce email-receipt document exported from an email message Prominently display the order identifier near the top and include a delivered status with a precise timestamp The line-items area show one product row, quantity, unit price, discount/promotion row, subtotal, shipping, tax, and final total in a structured grid subtle footer text such as customer support/contact info and a note that this is the email receipt for the delivered order Page 2 contain standard receipt boilerplate: return information, refund timing note, merchant contact details, and a compact transaction summary repeated in smaller type Use clean sans-serif typography, realistic spacing, table borders, muted gray dividers, and a professional retail invoice layout This invoice is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
- pricing dispute policy excerpt: Internal knowledge article document excerpt containing the exact pricing-dispute and expired-promotion rules needed to judge screenshot sufficiency and remedy eligibility. Extracted content: EC T18 Pricing Dispute Policy Excerpt Internal knowledge article document excerpt containing the exact pricing-dispute and expired-promotion rules needed to judge screenshot sufficiency and remedy eligibility. Details Document Title Pricing Dispute & Promotion Validation Policy Document Type Internal Knowledge Article Excerpt Policy Section Screenshot evidence requirements Rule A customer screenshot alone is insufficient unless it clearly shows the product name, advertised price or discount, and a visible date or active promotional validity window Rule If the screenshot does not show an active date or validity period, agents must rely on the order record and archived promotion data Policy Section Expired promotion handling Rule Expired, ended, or weekend-only promotions are not honored after the promotion period unless the order record shows the discount should have applied at checkout Rule For delivered orders with a pricing discrepancy, agents may offer a post-purchase credit only when the charged amount exceeds a verifiable active promotion at time of purchase Rule If the order receipt already includes the promotion that was advertised, no additional refund or credit is due for that same promotion Rule Identity verification is required before issuing any refund, credit, or billing adjustment Rule The order specialist must confirm final charged total, applied discount lines, and promotion eligibility from the receipt and order system before escalation Approval Note Courtesy credits for unverified promotional claims require supervisor approval Additional Information a realistic 2-page internal policy document excerpt from an ecommerce support knowledge base a sidebar or shaded note emphasizing evidence standards and a separate boxed note for agent actions or approval r
